newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Kovinotehna tumbles over six pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Kovinotehna tumbles over six pct.

text.p: Ordinary shares in trading company Kovinotehna tumbled 6.04 percent on the Ljubljana stock exchange on Monday as profit taking wiped out gains posted last week, traders said.
Kovinotehna fell 6.04 percent or 29 tolars to 451 tolars on volume of 1,314 shares. The blue-chip SBI index dropped 2.95 percent fall in the blue-chip SBI index.

"Kovinotehna as well as most other shares easily lost what they gained in four days of rises last week. There is not enough money on the market so it is natural that traders want to take some profit out of recent rises," one trader said. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
